individual.text_04.label: Students are counted once across all work types within the student-count dates. AM and
individual.text_04.default: Students are counted once across all work types within the student-count dates. AM and PM on the same date are two shifts. Student counts do not multiply educational hours.

individual.text_07.label: Only clinical experiences with student assignments in the selected period are listed.
individual.text_07.default: Only clinical experiences with student assignments in the selected period are listed. For those experiences, months without students remain included in availability.

individual.text_10.label: The minimum-shift count is the assessment-completion denominator.
individual.text_10.default: The minimum-shift count is the assessment-completion denominator.

chair.text_04.label: Academic Pediatrics combines HOPE_DRIVE, ETOWN and NYES. Ward A, PSHCH Nursery, Comple
chair.text_04.default: Academic Pediatrics combines HOPE_DRIVE, ETOWN and NYES. Ward A, PSHCH Nursery, Complex Care and other services remain separate. No additional weighting is applied by setting.

chair.text_06.label: All work types combined for each preceptor; these counts match the individual reports.
chair.text_06.default: All work types combined for each preceptor; these counts match the individual reports.

chair.text_07.label: Do not add student counts across preceptors: a student may appear under more than one
chair.text_07.default: Do not add student counts across preceptors: a student may appear under more than one preceptor. Student counts do not multiply educational hours.

chair.text_08.label: Preceptor detail by type of work
chair.text_08.default: Preceptor detail by type of work

chair.text_15.label: Both reporting dates are included. Boundary months contain only the selected dates; th
chair.text_15.default: Both reporting dates are included. Boundary months contain only the selected dates; the period is not split at July 1.

chair.text_16.label: Data review: at least one source rotation overlapping this year contains assignments w
chair.text_16.default: Data review: at least one source rotation overlapping this year contains assignments without an identifiable preceptor. Those assignments are excluded from provider totals; review Report_Notes.txt.

chair.text_17.label: Provider labels awaiting an individual name (not credited to a named preceptor)
chair.text_17.default: Provider labels awaiting an individual name (not credited to a named preceptor)

chair.text_18.label: Assignments awaiting an individual preceptor name
chair.text_18.default: Assignments awaiting an individual preceptor name

assessment.text_02.label: All students assessed counts each student once per form, regardless of scheduled shift
assessment.text_02.default: All students assessed counts each student once per form, regardless of scheduled shifts. The total counts each student once across either form, not once for each form. Only submitted records within the selected dates and cutoff are counted. Eligible students assessed is the subset meeting the minimum-shift requirement.

assessment.text_04.label: Total students assessed counts each student once across either submitted form, regardl
assessment.text_04.default: Total students assessed counts each student once across either submitted form, regardless of the number of shifts assigned. It includes students below the minimum or absent from the OPD; it is not the numerator of the completion percentage. Form-specific all-student totals are in the individual reports and completion CSV.

assessment.text_05.label: Form-result cells show evaluated eligible students / all eligible students (percentage
assessment.text_05.default: Form-result cells show evaluated eligible students / all eligible students (percentage). * Provisional: possible name discrepancies remain; no similar-name record was credited automatically. Each student counts once per preceptor/form type. 'Either form' counts the union, not the sum.

assessment.text_06.label: These are per-preceptor measures across all work types. Do not sum unique students acr
assessment.text_06.default: These are per-preceptor measures across all work types. Do not sum unique students across preceptors. The students-assigned table uses the same OPD identities, cutoff, and minimum-shift threshold.

assessment.text_09.label: The percentage column shows evaluated eligible students / all eligible students. A stu
assessment.text_09.default: The percentage column shows evaluated eligible students / all eligible students. A student assessed twice still counts once. The combined row counts either form, not the sum.

feedback.text_02.label: Evaluation count is the number of submitted forms, not the number of questions or uniq
feedback.text_02.default: Evaluation count is the number of submitted forms, not the number of questions or unique students. This section describes evaluations submitted during these dates; it is not restricted to the students counted in the OPD teaching section.

feedback.text_04.label: Means use the exported Multiple Choice Value for each question. Blank/N/A ratings are
feedback.text_04.default: Means use the exported Multiple Choice Value for each question. Blank/N/A ratings are excluded; Responses is the number of scored answers for that question. Not scored means no numeric answers were available. No composite score is calculated.

feedback.text_05.label: Comments are reproduced from the selected summary without rewriting. They may contain
feedback.text_05.default: Comments are reproduced from the selected summary without rewriting. They may contain identifying details; handle this document as evaluation data.

feedback.text_09.label: This is a mean of duration-category codes, not weeks, days, or a teaching-quality rati
feedback.text_09.default: This is a mean of duration-category codes, not weeks, days, or a teaching-quality rating.

pts_shared.time_definition.label: How hours and Learner Reach are calculated
pts_shared.time_definition.default: Total scheduled availability includes all recorded AM and PM shifts in the selected dates, with or without students, including weekends. Each shift represents four hours. Educational hours include only shifts with at least one student; two or more students in the same shift still count as four hours. Learner Reach is educational hours divided by total scheduled availability.

pts_shared.scope_note.label: What scheduled availability does and does not mean
pts_shared.scope_note.default: These are scheduled four-hour equivalents from saved OPDs, not verified total clinical work or attendance. Repeated listings count once. Existing outpatient-over-nursery priority is applied before counting. Unlisted work is not measured; future scheduled shifts within the selected dates are included.

pts_shared.participation.label: Who appears in the reports
pts_shared.participation.default: Only preceptors and work types with student assignments during the selected period are listed. Overall Learner Reach uses all recorded shifts for these preceptors, including shifts without students; category percentages use all shifts in that category.

pts_shared.detail_total.label: Explanation when detail subtotals differ from overall availability
pts_shared.detail_total.default: Overall total scheduled availability includes shifts in settings with no student assignments. Those settings are not listed separately, so the displayed availability subtotals may be lower than the overall total.

assessment.scope.label: Interpreting documented assessment completion
assessment.scope.default: This is a record-completeness measure, not a judgment of teaching quality. No assessment on file means not found in the loaded records, not overdue or never completed. An absent record may reflect a new student or an incomplete export. Provisional percentages use confirmed matches only and may change after a name correction. The two form types are shown separately; this report does not establish that both are required for every student.

assessment.method.label: Minimum-shift rule and assessment method
assessment.method.default: Eligible students were assigned to this preceptor on at least {minimum_shifts} distinct AM/PM {shift_word} in the reporting period. Each eligible student counts once per form type, even with several submitted forms. AM and PM on the same day are two shifts. Both assignment dates and OASIS Submit Date are limited to the reporting period through the Assessments as of date, inclusive. Students with no assessment on file remain in the denominator; the numerator includes only confirmed matches.

student_schedule.self_study.label: Protected Self-Study Time note
student_schedule.self_study.default: *Note* Protected Self-Study Time is reserved for independent learning and completion of required coursework. Students are encouraged to use this time to complete assignments, review course materials, prepare for patient care, and reinforce concepts encountered during the clerkship.

opd_workbook.crts.label: Clinical Reasoning Teaching Session instructions
opd_workbook.crts.default: Students are to alert their preceptors when they have a Clinical Reasoning Teaching Session (CRTS).  Please allow the students to leave approximately 15 minutes prior to the start of their session so they can be prepared to actively participate.  - Thank you!

primary_report.definition_2.label: Primary preceptor
primary_report.definition_2.default: Exactly one per student/week. The app prefers the highest-session preceptor with at least 3 sessions. If nobody reaches 3, the highest-session preceptor is still selected and flagged.

primary_report.definition_3.label: Repeated primary
primary_report.definition_3.default: The same preceptor may be primary for multiple students. Those primary rows are flagged for visibility.

primary_report.definition_5.label: Primary preceptor flag
primary_report.definition_5.default: YES when the selected primary has fewer than 3 sessions or the same preceptor is primary for multiple students that week.

primary_report.definition_6.label: Email mapping
primary_report.definition_6.default: Emails come from PRECEPTOR_EMAIL_MAP in the Streamlit source code.
